answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. The pulse is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. Reaching the tundra of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
